selection_rule: Separately for each dataset, lexicographically sort eligible IDs by (SHA256(UTF8(salt + canonical item_id)), item_id); choose the first 240. Serialize Japanese rows then English rows, each in rank order.
row_hash_serialization: UTF-8 json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)); no terminal newline. Question file appends LF after each row.
questions_file: questions.jsonl (external private data file; not in repository)
limitations: Project-unused in audited scope only; public benchmarks are not hidden tests and model pretraining overlap is unknown.
Exact question text disjointness is not semantic or translation disjointness.
Japanese and English are separate datasets, not translations or matched item pairs; language is confounded with dataset content.
Gold is copied into frozen records only after ID-based selection, for later evaluation; it is not input to model prompts or ranking.

dataset_split_packaging.description: Byte-identical per-dataset slices of the existing fixed 480-row file, made before any inference. No reordering or reselection.
